contradictions.topic: Claim amount versus documented medical charges

b.quote: Charges, this visit: 485.00 ... MRI lumbar/cervical (ordered, est.): 2,150.00

contradictions.note: About $2,635 in charges is documented against $59,533.85 claimed and paid. The provider bill, wage-loss records and settlement worksheet that might account for the difference are listed in the document index but are not on file.

a.quote: the causation link isn't airtight on the docs I have

b.quote: Med causation supported on re-read w/ full records + imaging.

contradictions.note: The causation finding rests on full records and imaging that are not on file. Only the one-page medical summary is available.

b.quote: Policy period not in the sample export; coverage is verified on the ClaimsPro Coverage screen.

contradictions.note: Policy status is unknown and the policy start and end dates are blank. The coverage verification listed in the index is not on file, so the coverage statement cannot be checked from the packet. This is a gap, not evidence of a lapse.

contradictions.topic: Onset of symptoms versus first care

a.quote: My neck's been bad since. ... I went in to the orthopedic place a couple days after

contradictions.note: A 3-day gap between the loss and first care is consistent with the caller's 'a couple days after'. Senior review noted the claimant 'worked through it before seeking care'.

contradictions.topic: Scene photo season versus date of loss

a.quote: Highway overlook with leafless trees and overcast, wet conditions

contradictions.note: Bare trees do not fit mid-September in western NY. The photo shows no vehicles involved in the loss and no date, so it is unclear whether it was taken at the loss or at another time. This needs confirming but does not affect the injury account on its own.

packet.rationale: The packet holds the claim header and status history (intake.md, status_history.md), the phone transcript (call_excerpt.md), the adjuster notes (adjuster_notes.md), a one-page medical summary (medical_summary.pdf) and three photos. The transcript, medical summary and claim header agree on the date of loss (2025-09-19) and the injuries reported. The 3-day gap before first care matches the claimant's account. The amount claimed and paid, $59,533.85, is supported on file by only $485.00 in visit charges and a $2,150.00 MRI estimate. The adjuster notes say causation and coverage were confirmed using full records, imaging and a coverage review, none of which is on file. Not on file are the police report, medical exam notes, imaging, provider bill, claimant statement, coverage verification, settlement worksheet and payment confirmation, though all are listed in the document index. The policy status and policy period are blank. The claim needs those records requested and placed on file so a person can review the amount, causation and coverage. Regulation requires human review of this claim regardless of route.
